item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Seema's aluminium strip. A flame heats the left end. Drawing pins P, Q, R and S are stuck with wax along the strip, with P nearest the flame and S farthest.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Heat moves by conduction from the hot end toward colder parts, so the pins fall in the order P, then Q, then R, then S.
options.B: Heat moves by conduction from the cold end toward the flame, so the pins fall in the order S, then R, then Q, then P.
options.C: Only pin P can fall, because heat never leaves the flame end of a solid strip.
options.D: All four pins fall at the same instant because aluminium is one solid piece.
